description: City of Fayetteville’s Watershed Master Plan is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by American Public Works Association; USGS, United States Geological Survey. In order to better assess the severity of city-wide floods and create flood mitigation solutions, Fayetteville, North Carolina’s city officials embarked on a $13 million Watershed Master Plan program in 2019. Coverage: North Carolina (2023). The toolkit gives North Carolina as the location, 2023 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
